29173-the-white-lie.creator: Unknown
29173-the-white-lie.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Apparently I was," replied Lieutenant Noel Barclay, of the Naval Flying Corps, a tall, slim, good-looking, clean-shaven man in aviator's garb, and wearing a thick woollen muffler and a brown leather cap with rolls at the ears, as he walked one August afternoon up the village street of Mundesley-on-Sea, in Norfolk, a quaint, old-world street swept by the fresh breeze of the North Sea.

64882-the-servile-state.creator: Hilaire Belloc
64882-the-servile-state.description: A book by Hilaire Belloc. omic revolution of the sixteenth century--The confiscation of monastic land--What might have happened had the State retained it--As a fact that land is captured by an oligarchy--England is Capitalist _before_ the advent of the industrial revolution--Therefore modern industry, proceeding from England, has grown in a Capitalist mould.

arxiv-2104-02374.title: Machine learning in interpretation of electronic core-level spectra
arxiv-2104-02374.creator: J. Niskanen, A. Vladyka, J. A. Kettunen, Ch. J. Sahle
arxiv-2104-02374.description: Abstract Electronic transitions involving core-level orbitals offer a localized, atomic-site and element specific peek window into statistical systems such as molecular liquids. Although formally understood, the complex relation between structure and spectrum – and the effect of statistical averaging of highly differing spectra of individual structures – render the analysis of an ensemble-averaged core-level spectrum complicated.

arxiv-2105-08939.title: Biharmonic CMC Hypersurfaces in the Warped Product Manifolds
arxiv-2105-08939.creator: N. Mosadegh, E. Abedi
arxiv-2105-08939.description: Abstract . We find the necessary and sufficient condition for the proper biharmonic CMC hypersurfaces in the special warped product space. Furthermore, we obtain that there exists no proper biharmonic CMC compact hypersurface there. 1 1 footnotetext: The second author is as corresponding author. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 53C42; Secondary 53C43, 53B25 1.

arxiv-2310-03088.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Accelerating Power System State Estimation
arxiv-2310-03088.creator: Solon Falas, Markos Asprou, Charalambos Konstantinou, Maria K. Michael
arxiv-2310-03088.description: Abstract State estimation is the cornerstone of the power system control center, since it provides the operating condition of the system in consecutive time intervals. This work investigates the application of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for accelerating power systems state estimation in monitoring the operation of power systems.

arxiv-2310-13449.title: Differential Calculus on Hypergraphs and Mayer-Vietoris Sequences for the Constrained Persistent Homology
arxiv-2310-13449.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . In this paper, we study the discrete differential calculus on hypergraphs by using the Kouzul complexes. We define the constrained (co)homology for hypergraphs and give the corresponding Mayer-Vietoris sequences. We prove the functoriality of the Mayer-Vietoris sequences for the constrained homology and the functoriality of the Mayer-Vietoris sequences for the constrained cohomology with respect to morphisms of hypergraphs induced by bijective maps between the vertices. Consequently, we obtain the Mayer-Vietoris sequences for the constrained persistent (co)homology for filtrations of hypergraphs.

arxiv-2311-00545.title: Tackling the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) with Object-centric Models and the MDL Principle
arxiv-2311-00545.creator: Sébastien Ferré
arxiv-2311-00545.description: Abstract The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is a challenging benchmark, introduced to foster AI research towards human-level intelligence. It is a collection of unique tasks about generating colored grids, specified by a few examples only. In contrast to the transformation-based programs of existing work, we introduce object-centric models that are in line with the natural programs produced by humans.

arxiv-2312-15117.title: On partitions with bounded largest part and fixed integral GBG-rank modulo primes
arxiv-2312-15117.creator: Alexander Berkovich, Aritram Dhar
arxiv-2312-15117.description: Abstract . In 2009, Berkovich and Garvan introduced a new partition statistic called the GBG-rank modulo t t which is a generalization of the well-known BG-rank. In this paper, we use the Littlewood decomposition of partitions to study partitions with bounded largest part and fixed integral value of GBG-rank modulo primes.

arxiv-2401-07852.title: On spectral outliers of inhomogeneous symmetric random matrices
arxiv-2401-07852.creator: Dylan J. Altschuler and Patrick Oliveira Santos and Konstantin Tikhomirov and Pierre Youssef
arxiv-2401-07852.description: Abstract . Sharp conditions for the presence of spectral outliers are well understood for Wigner random matrices with iid entries. In the setting of inhomogeneous symmetric random matrices (i.e., matrices with a non-trivial variance profile), the corresponding problem has been considered only recently.

arxiv-2401-14302.title: Correlation function and the inverse problem in the B ​ D BD interaction
arxiv-2401-14302.creator: Hai-Peng Li, Jing-Yu Yi, Chu-Wen Xiao, De-Liang Yao, Wei-Hong Liang, Eulogio Oset
arxiv-2401-14302.description: Abstract We study the correlation functions of the B 0 ​ D + , B + ​ D 0 B^{0}D^{+},B^{+}D^{0} system, which develops a bound state of approximately 40 ​ MeV 40\textrm{ MeV} , using inputs consistent with the T c ​ c ​ ( 3875 ) T_{cc}(3875) state.

arxiv-2403-19888.title: MambaMixer: Efficient Selective State Space Models with Dual Token and Channel Selection
arxiv-2403-19888.creator: Ali Behrouz, Michele Santacatterina, Ramin Zabih
arxiv-2403-19888.description: Abstract Recent advances in deep learning have mainly relied on Transformers due to their data dependency and ability to learn at scale. The attention module in these architectures, however, exhibit quadratic time and space in input size, limiting their scalability for long-sequence modeling.

arxiv-2404-06137.title: SmurfCat at SemEval-2024 Task 6: Leveraging Synthetic Data for Hallucination Detection
arxiv-2404-06137.creator: Elisei Rykov, Yana Shishkina, Kseniia Petrushina, Kseniia Titova, Sergey Petrakov, and Alexander Panchenko
arxiv-2404-06137.description: Abstract In this paper, we present our novel systems developed for the SemEval-2024 hallucination detection task. Our investigation spans a range of strategies to compare model predictions with reference standards, encompassing diverse baselines, the refinement of pre-trained encoders through supervised learning, and an ensemble approaches utilizing several high-performing models.

arxiv-2405-09753.creator: Qingchao Li, Graduate Student Member, IEEE, Mohammed El-Hajjar, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2405-09753.description: Abstract Large-scale multiple-input and multiple-output (MIMO) systems are capable of achieving high date rate. However, given the high hardware cost and excessive power consumption of massive MIMO systems, as a remedy, intelligent metasurfaces have been designed for efficient holographic MIMO (HMIMO) systems.

arxiv-2407-18177.title: Conformal quantum mechanics of causal diamonds: Time evolution, thermality, and instability via path integral functionals
arxiv-2407-18177.creator: H. E. Camblong, A. Chakraborty, P. Lopez-Duque, C. R. Ordóñez
arxiv-2407-18177.description: Abstract An observer with a finite lifetime 𝒯 \mathcal{T} perceives the Minkowski vacuum as a thermal state at temperature T D = 2 ​ ℏ / ( π ​ 𝒯 ) T_{D}=2\hbar/(\pi\mathcal{T}) , as a result of being constrained to a double-coned-shaped region known as a causal diamond.

arxiv-2408-08463.title: A theory of understanding for artificial intelligence: composability, catalysts, and learning
arxiv-2408-08463.creator: Zijian Zhang, Sara Aronowitz, Alán Aspuru-Guzik
arxiv-2408-08463.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zijian Zhang, Sara Aronowitz, Alán Aspuru-Guzik. Understanding is a crucial yet elusive concept in artificial intelligence (AI). This work proposes a framework for analyzing understanding based on the notion of composability. Given any subject (e.g., a person or an AI), we suggest characterizing its understanding of an object in terms of its ability to process (compose) relevant inputs into satisfactory outputs from the perspective of a verifier. This highly universal framework can readily apply to non-human subjects, such as AIs, non-human animals, and institutions.

arxiv-2509-03857.title: Continuous Monitoring of Large-Scale Generative AI via Deterministic Knowledge Graph Structures
arxiv-2509-03857.creator: Kishor Datta Gupta, Mohd Ariful Haque, Hasmot Ali, Marufa Kamal, Syed Bahauddin Alam, Mohammad Ashiqur Rahman
arxiv-2509-03857.description: Abstract Generative AI (GEN AI) models have revolutionized diverse application domains but present substantial challenges due to reliability concerns, including hallucinations, semantic drift, and inherent biases. These models typically operate as black-boxes, complicating transparent and objective evaluation. Current evaluation methods primarily depend on subjective human assessment, limiting scalability, transparency, and effectiveness.

arxiv-2602-11959.creator: Moshe Babaioff, Yiding Feng, Zihan Luo
arxiv-2602-11959.description: Abstract The classic result of Bulow and Klemperer, 1996 shows that in multi-unit auctions with m m units and n ≥ m n\geq m buyers whose values are sampled i.i.d. from a regular distribution, the revenue of the VCG auction with m m additional buyers is at least as large as the optimal revenue.

pmc-10744332.title: Kernel Transcriptome Profiles of Susceptible Wheat Genotypes in Response to Wheat Dwarf Bunt
pmc-10744332.creator: Shenqiang Su, Zihao Zhang, Tong Shen, Jing Chen, Qi Liu
pmc-10744332.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Wheat dwarf bunt is caused by Tilletia controversa J. Kühn (TCK), which is a serious fungal diseases affecting kernels of wheat. In order to identify candidate genes involved in the abnormal development of kernels in wheat, we used RNA sequencing technology to analyze the transcriptome of the abnormal and healthy kernels of a susceptible variety (Yili053) at the mid-filling stage, late-filling stage, and maturity stage, respectively.

pmc-10746280.title: Bacterial efflux pump modulators prevent bacterial growth in macrophages and under broth conditions that mimic the host environment
pmc-10746280.creator: Samual C. Allgood, Chih-Chia Su, Amy L. Crooks, Christian T. Meyer, Bojun Zhou, Meredith D. Betterton, Michael R. Barbachyn, Edward W. Yu, Corrella S. Detweiler
pmc-10746280.description: New approaches for combating microbial infections are needed. One strategy for disrupting pathogenesis involves developing compounds that interfere with bacterial virulence. A critical molecular determinant of virulence for Gram-negative bacteria are efflux pumps of the resistance-nodulation-division family, which includes AcrAB-TolC. We previously identified small molecules that bind AcrB, inhibit AcrAB-TolC, and do not appear to damage membranes.

pmc-11548542.title: Analysis of the Dispersive and Distributive Mixing Effect of Screw Elements on the Co-Rotating Twin-Screw Extruder with Particle Tracking
pmc-11548542.creator: Jan Philipp Oldemeier, Volker Schöppner
pmc-11548542.description: Compounding is an important step in processing base polymers and is used to incorporate various additives into a polymer. For this purpose, different screw elements are used for dispersive and distributive mixing on a co-rotating twin-screw extruder. Optimising the screw configuration requires precise knowledge of the screw elements’ mixing properties, which have not been thoroughly investigated.

pmc-11656298.title: Experimental validation of a FLUKA Monte Carlo simulation for carbon‐ion radiotherapy monitoring via secondary ion tracking
pmc-11656298.creator: Pamela Ochoa‐Parra, Luisa Schweins, Nelly Abbani, Laura Ghesquière‐Diérickx, Tim Gehrke, Jan Jakubek, Lukas Marek, Carlos Granja, Fabian Dinkel, Gernot Echner, Marcus Winter, Andrea Mairani, Semi Harrabi, Oliver Jäkel, Jürgen Debus, Mária Martišíková, Laurent Kelleter
pmc-11656298.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundIn‐vivo monitoring methods of carbon ion radiotherapy (CIRT) includes explorations of nuclear reaction products generated by carbon‐ion beams interacting with patient tissues. Our research group focuses on in‐vivo monitoring of CIRT using silicon pixel detectors. Currently, we are conducting a prospective clinical trial as part of the In‐Vivo Monitoring project (InViMo) at the Heidelberg Ion Beam Therapy Center (HIT) in Germany.

pmc-12466986.title: Activin A Secreted by Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts Reduces the Sensitivity of Breast Cancer Cells to Ixazomib via Inhibition of Proteasome Activity
pmc-12466986.creator: Shuaiming Geng, Siyao Liu, He Liu, Siao Wang, Yichen Niu, Jing Gao, Yong Meng, Mingqing Gao, Norbert Nass, Tracey Martin
pmc-12466986.description: Breast cancer (BC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality among women globally, and the role of cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) in promoting BC progression is well established. Ixazomib, a proteasome inhibitor approved for the treatment of multiple myeloma, has demonstrated therapeutic potential in BC in preclinical trials.

pmc-12606274.title: The relationship between social support, life satisfaction and problematic WeChat use among college students
pmc-12606274.creator: Ting Li, Yanjie Shan, Yadong Sun, Ke Chen
pmc-12606274.description: Investigating the risk factors and underlying mechanisms of problematic WeChat use(PWU) holds significant promise for preemptively addressing and mitigating such behaviors among college students, thereby fostering improvements in their mental well-being. The present study aims to characterize PWU and to examine differences in social support and life satisfaction potentially across these profiles.

pmc-12692936.title: Nanoscale Imaging of Biological Tissues: Techniques, Challenges and Emerging Frontiers
pmc-12692936.creator: Rohit Kajla, Rebecca Leija-Cardenas, Meghraj Magadi Shivalingaiah, Muhammad Waqas Shabbir, Zihao Ou
pmc-12692936.description: Nanoscale characterization of biological tissues bridges molecular identity with structural, mechanical, and chemical organization, enabling high-resolution insights into intact specimens. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the principal imaging modalities that resolve cellular and subcellular features in biological tissues. Electron microscopy techniques offer ultrastructural details and volumetric reconstructions with sectioning and tomography techniques.

pmc-12733453.title: MASLD: Lipotoxicity and Imaging Parallels from Liver Steatosis to Kidney Injury
pmc-12733453.creator: Sarmis Marian Săndulescu, Denisa Ștefania Ghiga, Diana Rodica Tudorașcu, Daniela Larisa Săndulescu, Adrian Mită, Marinela Cristiana Urhuț, Citto-Iulian Taisescu, Panagiotis Georgianos
pmc-12733453.description: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is recognized as a systemic condition that is associated with an increased prevalence of chronic kidney disease (CKD), independent of classical risk factors. This review explores MASLD and metabolic kidney dysfunction, emphasizing lipotoxicity, emerging biomarkers, and liver–kidney fat imaging techniques.

pmc-12966219.title: Pediatric shoulder instability: epidemiology, etiology, diagnosis and treatment
pmc-12966219.creator: Alp Paksoy, Philipp Moroder, Doruk Akgün
pmc-12966219.description: AbstractShoulder instability is increasingly prevalent among pediatric and adolescent populations due to growing participation in competitive sports at younger ages. However, the literature remains challenging to apply clinically, as it often fails to distinguish between different developmental stages, leading to potential overtreatment or undertreatment.

pmc-13141132.title: Engagement with behaviour change in people with mild cognitive impairment and mild frailty: a qualitative study
pmc-13141132.creator: Tasmin Alanna Rookes, Rachael Frost, Yolanda Barrado-Martín, Jessica Catchpole, Megan Armstrong, Benjamin Gardner, Rebecca L Gould, Claudia Cooper, Cecilia Hammond, Louise Marston, Kate R Walters
